description:
Stop videos from pausing when you switch tabs.

Focus Spoofer stops websites from detecting when you switch tabs, minimize Chrome or move to another window, so videos, streams and lectures keep playing while you multitask.

Useful for:
• TikTok videos that stop when Chrome loses focus
• Twitch streams that pause when you switch tabs
• Online courses and lecture players that pause or flag you as "inactive"
• Timers, animations and "Are you still there?" prompts that trigger when you look away

How it works
Turn it on for the tab you're watching, or tick "Always protect this site" to cover it on every visit. The tab reloads once so protection starts before the site's own scripts. From then on the page always sees a visible, focused tab:
• Tab switches and minimizing stay hidden (document.hidden stays false)
• Other windows and apps stay hidden (hasFocus() stays true, window blur never reaches the page)
• Video and animation callbacks keep running in the background, including inside embedded players
• Optional fingerprint randomization (canvas, WebGL, audio), which you can turn off in Settings

Buttons, forms and menus inside the page keep working normally.

See it work: focus.oddworks.us/test

Private by design: no account, and your browsing history and page content never leave your browser. Optional anonymous usage stats are off unless you turn them on.

It can't run on chrome:// pages or the Chrome Web Store, and it isn't meant to get around proctoring or anti-cheat software.
